name: workflow-modes
description: Persist and remind agents about discuss, plan, and execute workflow modes across long Codex sessions and context compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Keep discuss, plan, and execute modes durable.
interface.longDescription: Workflow Modes provides dormant lifecycle hooks that persist active mode metadata outside model context, restore it after compaction, and remind agents of mode focus and mandatory tracker/plan completeness with a one-time post-compaction read gate before task mutations and nonblocking final reporting.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $discuss, $plan, or $execute with durable records and nonblocking mode reminders.
